pages.title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Fit blocks into stone tablet puzzles in Treasure Hunt Puzzle. Use the symbols to decide where each piece belongs, then tap to rotate and drag it into place to uncover treasure.

pages.title: Transform Car Battle
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Steer around lasers and collect energy cubes in Transform Car Battle. Swipe to dodge while driving, then tap at the right moment to transform and face the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Build descending runs in Spider Solitaire by moving cards between columns. Uncover cards beneath the stacks, then remove complete suit sequences until the board is clear.

pages.title: Celebrity E-Girl Vibes
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together a celebrity streetwear look in Celebrity E-Girl Vibes. Try a colorful hairstyle, graphic eyeliner, and pieces such as oversized hoodies or ripped jeans.

pages.title: Family Squid Challenge
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Team up with a friend in Family Squid Challenge. Collect keys while staying away from the red- and black-masked guards. You need to get both players through the level alive.

pages.title: Squid Game Hunter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Play a knife-wielding hunter in Squid Game Hunter. Approach enemies carefully and choose when to strike as you complete missions and collect the rewards they offer.

pages.title: Medieval Escape
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Search medieval rooms in Medieval Escape. Click objects to find items and clues, then use them to work through riddles and discover a route out.

pages.title: Draw Bridge: Brain Game
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Draw a bridge in Draw Bridge: Brain Game to help a car get past hazards. Think about where the wheels will meet your line and shape it toward the destination.

pages.title: Bubble it jam
pages.creator: Funnyplus
pages.description: Shoot matching colors to pop clusters in Bubble it jam. Plan shots around the bubbles in the way and free the ropes as you work toward each level's goal.

pages.title: Dice Fusion
pages.creator: Puppy Yolk Studio
pages.description: Drag dice together in Dice Fusion to make new values. Check the goal for the current level before moving a die, and make the merges that take you toward its reward.

pages.title: Words with Prof. Wisely
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Link letters to uncover words in Words with Prof. Wisely. Use each answer to work through the crossword and try a different starting letter when a word eludes you.

pages.title: Mad Truck
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Balance a vehicle on platforms and ramps in Mad Truck. Try the side-view levels to practice keeping it steady, or take on different obstacles in Challenge mode.

pages.title: Ninja Crossword Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Complete the words in Ninja Crossword Challenge. Look at the letters already in the grid and use their positions to narrow down what can fit into the remaining squares.

pages.title: Warping Bat
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Bounce between springs in Warping Bat to pick up every coin. Plan around hazards in each layout and use the last pickup to open the exit gate.

pages.title: Shadow Stickman Fight
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Survive waves of ninjas in Shadow Stickman Fight. Pass belt exams to earn the examiner's equipment, and use the souls you collect to trade for items.

pages.title: Radiation Zone
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Fight zombies and armed enemies in Radiation Zone. Search the area for weapons and ammunition, and use the inventory to keep track of what you collect on the mission.

pages.title: Mini Duels Battle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Pick a short game in Mini Duels Battle. Try wrestling, Drunken Boxing, or a table game, and switch to a different duel when you want another challenge with a friend.

pages.title: Classic Solitaire: Time and Score
pages.creator: Filgame
pages.description: Sort a standard deck in Classic Solitaire: Time and Score. Arrange cards on the board to reveal the ones underneath, then build up the suit piles to complete the round.

pages.title: Kawaii Memory - Card Matching Game
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Find matching pictures in Kawaii Memory - Card Matching Game. Remember where fruits, slimes, and animals appear as you turn over cards, then clear the board by pairing them.

pages.title: Super Samurai
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Survive the timed fights in Super Samurai and take on a tougher group of enemies at each level. Use the diamonds you earn to strengthen the samurai and learn new skills.

pages.title: House Design Match 3
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Restore rooms and outdoor spaces in House Design Match 3. Complete candy puzzles to work on the mansion, from the interior to its balcony, yard, and swimming pool.

pages.title: Marble Puzzle Blast
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Aim marbles into matching groups in Marble Puzzle Blast. Use the color of each shot to plan where it belongs and help the caterpillars become butterflies as you clear levels.

pages.title: Bloxcape
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Free the star-marked block in Bloxcape. Slide the other blocks around the cramped board and check which moves make space for the starred piece to get out.

pages.title: Red and Green Rainbow
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Find the key with a partner in Red and Green Rainbow. Use jump ramps to get past slimes and bats, and send the green character to remove the barriers only they can clear.

pages.title: Escape from Deathmark Dungeon
pages.creator: Matt Lloyd
pages.description: Choose a ranger or wizard in Escape from Deathmark Dungeon. Fight elves, goblins, and undead enemies across seven dungeon levels as you look for a way to escape.

pages.title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear card layouts with Foxy in Solitaire Story TriPeaks 3. Play cards one rank above or below the current card as the journey takes you to places such as Paris and Bali.

pages.title: Onet Mahjong
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Select matching pairs of tiles in Onet Mahjong. Look for a pair you can connect, then see which other tiles are available to link after it disappears.

pages.title: Steal the Meal
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Help mice get a sausage to the cat in Steal the Meal. Plan how to move through the crowded refrigerator and deliver what the cat is waiting for.

pages.title: Bug War
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Send ants or roaches to capture territory in Bug War. Balance expansion with defense and take over enemy positions until your colony is the only one left.

pages.title: Planting And Making of Food
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Follow everyday ingredients from planting to preparation in Planting And Making of Food. See how corn grows and help turn chilies into powder as you work through the activities.

pages.title: Path Control
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Shift objects with clicks in Path Control to make a ball roll toward a basket. Look at what will move when you click and use the changing setup to direct the ball.

pages.title: Monster Truck Destroyer
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Drive a monster truck through destructible obstacles in Monster Truck Destroyer. Judge your speed and balance as you climb over wreckage and keep moving through the course.

pages.title: Cool Score
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Line up a soccer shot in Cool Score. Wait for an angle that avoids defenders and obstacles, then kick toward the goal. Unlock different looks for the ball as you play.

pages.title: Drunken Slap Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stop the power meter in the green zone in Drunken Slap Wars. Time your slaps to beat your opponent, and adjust as later rounds give you a tougher rival.

pages.title: FNF Music Battle 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tap the correct rhythm signals in FNF Music Battle 3D. Follow the beat through each music battle and help the boy keep the upper hand as the song progresses.

pages.title: Pop It Fidget NOW
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Pop every bubble in Pop It Fidget NOW to unlock another shape. Click or tap around each toy, and try changing its colors or sounds before starting the next figure.

pages.title: Super Friday Night Funki
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Press the onscreen inputs to the beat in Super Friday Night Funki. Keep track of when each note reaches its mark, then build up your score by staying in rhythm.

pages.title: LaneChage 3D
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Guide a car through endless traffic in LaneChage 3D. Check the next lane before moving over, and leave enough space to avoid the cars as the road gets busier.

pages.title: Pin And Balls
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pull pins in Pin And Balls to send enough colored balls into the bucket. Look at the obstacles inside the pipe and choose the order that gets the balls past them.

pages.title: Pole Vault Jump
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Time the vault in Pole Vault Jump so your athlete clears the obstacle ahead of the others. Try different characters or poles as you work on the approach and jump.

pages.title: Among Them Horror 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Solve a puzzle and reach the final door in Among Them Horror 3D. Move with WASD or the arrows and use E to interact or hide when the enemy gets close.

pages.title: Crazy Racing 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Get past obstacles before the other cars in Crazy Racing 2020. Use the mouse and time your moves through the course so you can reach the finish ahead of the pack.

pages.title: Soccer Caps Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Play tabletop football in Soccer Caps Game. Pick a national team, then drag a cap to set the direction and power of its shot. Score goals to win the cup.

pages.title: Color and Decorate Rooms
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Color a living room, kitchen, bedroom, or bathroom in Color and Decorate Rooms. Once you've painted the picture, add furniture stickers to give the room your own layout.

pages.title: Paint.IO
pages.creator: GAMEE
pages.description: Claim territory in Paint.IO by leaving your area and looping back. Use the arrows to steer, and protect your trail from rivals while you're outside your own color.

pages.title: Retro Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a classic car in Retro Cars Jigsaw and drag the shuffled pieces into place. Use the outline and body details to rebuild the picture.

pages.title: PinataCraft
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Break blocky monster piñatas in PinataCraft. Click or tap to attack and work through the levels as you travel to new areas and face more monsters.

pages.title: Nail Doctor
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Treat patients with injured toes in Nail Doctor. Use the provided tools and follow the steps for each injury as you work through the appointments.

pages.title: Heavy Cargo Truck Driver
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Take a cargo truck into the hills in Heavy Cargo Truck Driver. Use the arrow keys and manage your speed over rough ground and around bends.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pop
pages.creator: Motion Studio
pages.description: Pop matching bubbles in Bubble Shooter Pop. Aim each shot into the cluster and work through the layouts as you collect medals for your progress.

pages.title: GTA: Save My City
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pursue suspects in GTA: Save My City. Drive a police car through the city and complete the chase missions, using the siren to alert people nearby.

pages.title: Adorable Monster Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over monster pictures in Adorable Monster Memory and find every identical pair. Remember where the pictures are and try to clear each of the four boards with fewer moves.

pages.title: Scary Evil Monsters Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of frightening creatures in Scary Evil Monsters Jigsaw. Choose from twelve images and a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Poker with Friends
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play Texas Hold'em with virtual chips in Poker with Friends. Compete in a public game or create a private room so you can play with people you know.

pages.title: Puzzles
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fit animals, vehicles, and shapes into the right spaces in Puzzles. Drag each cutout onto the matching outline and look at its edges if you're unsure where it belongs.

pages.title: Dark Rider
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Ride stunt tracks in Dark Rider and try to finish without falling. Choose between two difficulties, then replay levels to improve the high score for each course.

pages.title: Random Spin Wheel Earn Vbucks
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin a wheel and read where the pointer stops in Random Spin Wheel Earn Vbucks. Each round centers on the result displayed by the wheel.

pages.title: Knightower
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Climb as high as you can in Knightower. Use the left and right arrows or touchscreen to steer between climbing spots and build a higher score.

pages.title: Moto Beach Ride
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Ride along the beach in Moto Beach Ride. Use WASD to guide the bike through rings and try stunts, or switch modes to change the challenge.

pages.title: Car Eats Car 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Outrun pursuing cars in Car Eats Car 2. Use turbo to create distance, drop bombs when enemies close in, and upgrade your ride before the next escape.

pages.title: Cricket Online
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Play both batting and bowling turns in Cricket Online. Create a game room for friends and see who can score the most while taking turns in both roles.

pages.title: 6x6 Offroad Truck Driving Sim 2018
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive a heavy truck on long routes in 6x6 Offroad Truck Driving Sim 2018. Manage the vehicle through different terrain and allow room to steer on narrower sections.

pages.title: Truck Factory For Kids
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Build a vehicle from parts in Truck Factory For Kids. Use the mouse or touchscreen to fit the pieces, take the truck out on a job, and wash it after the work is done.

pages.title: Classic 1990 Racing 3D
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Race with the arrow keys in Classic 1990 Racing 3D. Judge the next turn as you drive through courses inspired by the arcade racers of the eighties and nineties.

pages.title: Monsters Impact
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap to attack monsters in Monsters Impact. Use the special buttons when you need extra power, and keep hitting the creatures as new enemies arrive.

pages.title: Stickman Saw 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide colored blocks into saws in Stickman Saw 3D. Use the mouse or keyboard to move, and avoid cutting through anything that could endanger the stickman you're trying to rescue.

pages.title: Block Craft Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two scenes in Block Craft Differences and select the details that change. Check the blocks and their surroundings until you find everything needed to finish the level.

pages.title: Delicious Halloween Cupcake
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Make Halloween cupcakes in Delicious Halloween Cupcake. Use the mouse to follow the recipe and finish the cupcakes with decorations for the holiday.

pages.title: Scary Halloween Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Match three or more Halloween pictures in Scary Halloween Match 3. Make new groups quickly to raise your score before the meter on the left falls too low.

pages.title: Halloween Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose your colors for a spooky drawing in Halloween Coloring Time. Click or tap to paint the picture and try different shades for its smaller details and background.

pages.title: PUBG PIXEL2
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Fight to be the last survivor in PUBG PIXEL2. Move through the block-built battlefield and watch for rivals as you try to survive the match alone or with a team.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Marbles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot marbles into groups of three or more in Bubble Shooter Marbles. Aim for matching colors and keep clearing until none remain. The next level gives you a different layout.

pages.title: Electrical Monsters Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match three or more electric monsters in Electrical Monsters Match 3. Build up your score with each group, and keep making moves before the meter drops too far.

pages.title: Snakes and Ladders
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Roll the dice and move along the board in Snakes and Ladders. Ladders send you forward and snakes send you back. Try to reach the finish before the other players.

pages.title: Soft Teacher Dress up
pages.creator: DUGS
pages.description: Style a high-school teacher in Soft Teacher Dress up. Choose clothes that work together for a day in class, then try a different combination from the wardrobe.

pages.title: Will Hero Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Jump, dash, and fight with one control in Will Hero Online. Time each move through enemies and obstacles, then try to beat your score and collect more costumes.

pages.title: Color Rings
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Place rings of different sizes onto the grid in Color Rings. Look for ways to line up matching colors and clear space before you run out of useful places to drop a ring.

pages.title: Merge Animals
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Merge matching animal defenders in Merge Animals. Build up the group that guards their home and choose which defenders to improve as new enemies move into range.

pages.title: Donuts Match 3
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Match groups of doughnuts in Donuts Match 3. Use the mouse to work through the boards and look for chances to use power-ups as the levels get harder.

pages.title: Penalty Kick
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swipe a shot past the keeper in Penalty Kick. Read the positions of the goalkeeper and defenders, then choose a path to the net and see how often you can score.

pages.title: Tower Ball 3D
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Smash platforms on the way down in Tower Ball 3D. Avoid the black sections until the ball is moving fast enough to catch fire and break through them.

pages.title: EG Mad Scientist
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fight through six levels in EG Mad Scientist. Pick up weapons and improvement items as you go, and watch how different enemies approach before deciding when to fire.

pages.title: Knock Down Hit
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Launch shots from a slingshot in Knock Down Hit. Aim at the stacked cans and think about which one will bring the others down with it.

pages.title: Alien Infestation FPS
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight alien enemies with a selection of weapons in Alien Infestation FPS. Move with WASD or the arrows and aim with the mouse as you level up across two modes.

pages.title: Kids Truck Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together truck pictures in Kids Truck Puzzle. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard, then take your time matching the outlines and colors to complete each picture.

pages.title: EG Zombies City
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Recruit people into your horde in EG Zombies City. Gather more zombies as you move through the city and use your growing crowd to take on rival groups.

pages.title: Ketchapp Football
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Swipe to kick balls at targets in Ketchapp Football. Try three modes and use the result of each shot to refine your aim as you work toward a leaderboard score.

pages.title: EG Hexar 2048
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Move numbered hexagons in EG Hexar 2048. Drag pieces into position to make matching groups and use the space you clear to work through each puzzle.

pages.title: Traffic Car Racing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Explore city streets in a sports car in Traffic Car Racing. Drive through the center and see what routes you can find as you move around the other vehicles.

pages.title: Plumber Touch
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Rotate pipes to restore the flow in Plumber Touch. Start at one end and follow each segment until you have a continuous connection from point A to point B.

pages.title: Switch Dash
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Switch the platform between black and white in Switch Dash. Watch the next ball falling toward it and choose the matching color before it reaches the platform.

pages.title: Emoji Limax
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Boost to leave a trail in Emoji Limax and try to get other players to run into it. Avoid their trails and grow as you outlast more rivals.

pages.title: Tower Builder
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Release blocks at the right moment in Tower Builder. Keep the stack balanced as it rises, since a misplaced block costs a life and makes the next drop more important.

pages.title: Vex 4
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Run, jump, slide, and swim past hazards in Vex 4. Use WASD or the arrows, then try the hard modes or Challenge Room after working through the acts.

pages.title: Aladdin Adventure
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Run through five worlds in Aladdin Adventure. Guide Aladdin past enemies on his search for gold and keep going until you face the final boss.

pages.title: Princess Tinder Wars
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare dating profiles for the princesses in Princess Tinder Wars. Help each one put together a look for her profile before she starts meeting people.

pages.title: Sneaky James
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Plot a route away from the guards in Sneaky James. Tap to set a path and use the shaded areas to keep James out of sight while you get away.

pages.title: WarehousePANIC.io
pages.creator: Rezoner
pages.description: Fit pieces together before the ship arrives in WarehousePANIC.io. Look for shapes that can form full squares and try to complete as many square blocks as you can.

pages.title: Princesses Winter Holiday
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get three princesses ready for a ski trip in Princesses Winter Holiday. Pick cold-weather outfits, gloves, hats, and gear before they head onto the slopes in Arendelle.

pages.title: Princess Winter Skiing
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress a princess for the mountain in Princess Winter Skiing. Choose her outfit and decide whether she will take skis or a snowboard on her winter outing.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Costumes
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Find spooky outfits for Ellie and Annie in Princess Halloween Costumes. Try the costume pieces on both princesses and pick the look you'd send each one out in.

pages.title: Bionic Race
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Tap to jump in Bionic Race and keep your runner clear of the obstacles. Pick up coins as the course goes by and try to beat your best score.

pages.title: Speed Math
pages.creator: Thanh Huy Ly
pages.description: Answer addition and subtraction problems against the clock in Speed Math. Choose among the three possible results as quickly as you can and keep the run going with correct answers.

pages.title: Boom Dots
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Launch your dot at moving targets in Boom Dots. Watch where the next dot is headed before firing, and aim for a precise hit to earn double points.

pages.title: Princess Summer Make UP!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give a mermaid princess a warm-weather makeover in Princess Summer Make UP! Try different makeup shades and choose the combination you want her to wear for summer.

pages.title: Trapped in Halloween
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Jump through Candyland with Pinkie in Trapped in Halloween. Collect candy and find keys for chests that hold pieces of her costume. Guide her around the obstacles as you put the outfit together.

pages.title: Girls PJ Party!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress three princesses for a sleepover in Girls PJ Party! Browse the pajama choices and give each friend something to wear for the party at home.

pages.title: Baby Mermaid Princess Dress Up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style a young mermaid for a special event in Baby Mermaid Princess Dress Up. Change her eye color and top, then choose jewelry and a crown.

pages.title: Elsa Mommy Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Elsa get ready for the hospital in Elsa Mommy Twins Birth. Pack her bag and stay with her until help arrives, then care for the twins afterward.
